deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall 2027 are due December 15, 2026.

also.quote: Students applying for fall should submit a complete application package no later than December 15 (PhD applicants)

gre_general.value: The department lists the GRE as optional.
gre_general.quote: (Optional) Unofficial GRE scores that are fewer than five years old

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact potential research advisors by email before or shortly after applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants to the PhD program are strongly encouraged to reach out to potential research advisors via email either before or shortly after submitting the application

funding.value: TA, RA and fellowship awards go to top applicants; the page does not say all admitted students are funded.
funding.quote: These are awarded to top applicants who are interested in pursuing the PhD degree and are a good match with our research and our faculty

entry_route.value: A PhD takes 48 credits after a master's or 72 after a bachelor's; a master's is strongly encouraged.
entry_route.quote: 48 credits beyond the master's or 72 credits beyond the bachelor's degree

also.quote: strongly encouraged from those who already possess a master's degree and wish to pursue the PhD

notes: Combined ELEC/CSYS doctorate; the page does not cover computer science. Admission requires a TOEFL or IELTS for international applicants without a US degree (no minimum stated on the department page).
